name: 360 One Wam Limited
summary: 360 One Wam Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides wealth and asset management services in India. It operates through the Wealth Management and Asset Management segments. The Wealth Management segment engages in the distribution of financial products, advisory, broking and research, discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management services, corporate treasury solutions, estate planning, and managing financial products in advisory. This segment is also involved in lending and investment activities.
